parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and defines the overall shape of the cabinet, holding all other parts together.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports the doors, shelves, and base.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the cabinet and ensures stability on the floor.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space and supports stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height depending on design.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left cabinet door is a hinged panel made of MDF with a handle for opening.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cabinet interior and protects stored items from dust.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right cabinet door is a hinged panel made of MDF with a handle for opening.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the cabinet’s right compartment and protects contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.
